name: Suzuki GSX-R600
engine: 599 cc liquid-cooled DOHC inline four, fuel injected
intro: Suzuki's 600 supersport. Check the front brake recall on 2011-2013 bikes and look hard for crash damage.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2004-2013 GSX-R600s were in recall 13V449 for front brake master cylinder corrosion.
A-002.reason: A corroded piston gives a soft lever and longer stops. The repair is free.

E: Check the frame spars, subframe and fairing mounts for scrapes and cracks. Track and street crashes are common on these.

recalls.what: Front brake master cylinder piston can corrode, giving a soft lever.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the master cylinder parts free.
